# Transcript TikTok

> Transcript TikTok is a browser-based tool for turning accessible public videos from TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram into readable transcript text.

## Canonical website
- https://transcriptiktok.vercel.app/

## Supported platforms
- TikTok public video links, including supported short links.
- YouTube public videos and Shorts, including youtu.be links.
- Facebook public video links, including supported fb.watch links.
- Instagram public Reels and video posts.

## Main features
- Submit one public video URL at a time.
- Generate transcript text through the server-side transcript provider.
- Copy the result or export it as TXT or JSON where available.
- No account is required for the basic single-video workflow.

## Important limitations
- Only accessible public links from the supported platforms are accepted.
- Private, deleted, restricted, or inaccessible videos may fail.
- Transcript quality and availability depend on audio quality and upstream provider capacity.
- The tool processes one video per request; it does not promise unlimited usage, bulk processing, cloud-synced accounts, team features, or guaranteed transcription.
- Review transcripts before quoting or publishing.
